description: The individual will be able to impart theoretical instructions, demonstrate practical skills, evaluate and grade trainees of Electrician and related trades in ITIs/ Vocational Training Institutes, industrial workshops, etc

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Ensure implementation of safe working practices, environment regulation and housekeeping.
Explain verification and measurement of different characteristics of electrical circuits.
Demonstrate installations, testing and maintenance of batteries and solar cells.
Train to estimate, assemble, install and test various wiring systems, winding and Insulating materials.
Explain verification and measure characteristics of Magnetic effect of electric current, parts of DC Generator, DC motor Power factors.
Evaluate testing, performance and maintenance of transformer.
Monitor testing, check connections, verify errors, calibrate various instruments and electrical Illumination systems.
Assess construction of simple electronic circuits and test for functioning.
Demonstrate planning, execution, commissioning and performance of various AC motors and Alternator/ MG set.
Analyse detection of faults and troubleshooting of inverter, stabilizer, UPS etc.
Demonstrate estimation, testing, servicing and troubleshooting components of domestic/industrial programmable systems and their control circuits.
Plan, execute, commission and evaluate performance of various conventional/non-conventional power generation, transmission and distribution components
Demonstrate installation and troubleshooting of Electric Vehicle charging stations.
Read and apply engineering drawing for different application in the field of work
Demonstrate basic mathematical concept and principles to perform practical operations. Understand and explain basic science in the field of study.
Plan and prepare the learners for the class using basics of educational psychology and motivational techniques.
Analyze the syllabus of the Course.
Plan and prepare the training session using various methods viz. 4 step method, question and questioning technique etc.
Communicate effectively with the trainees both verbally and nonverbally.
Use Instructional Technology and facilitate the training program.
Design written instructional materials and implement for imparting training.
Assess, evaluate and certify the tests.
Organize workshop and classroom learning observing instructional methods.
Counsel and mentor the trainees by identifying their Strength and Weaknesses.
Develop Entrepreneurship skills.
Apply ICT and Internet in training (computer-based training) and various types of Distance learning programmes.
Plan and conduct sessions to impart competency based skills and knowledge.
Apply Adult Learning Principles.
Develop and implement continuous professional development plan.
Develop employability skills for the industrial needs.
Develop future skills in Emerging Technology.
On the Job Training (OJT)

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.COMPLETEDSPECIALIZATION: Electrical/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized Engineering College / University.
Electrical/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering after class 10th from AICTE/ recognized board of technical education.

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.RELEVANTSPECIALIZATION: Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR.

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.LTTSTTCOMPLETED: 02 years NTC/NAC passed in the trade of Electrician

horizontalPathName: Technical Instructor in a vocational training Institute/ technical Institution, Supervisor in Industries
